prompt:

Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text

Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.

text:
18/03/26, 6:45 pm - Raju bhai: Haan bhai, aaj ki training case study ready hai?
18/03/26, 6:48 pm - Pooja R.: Haan Raju bhai, QR code scam waala scenario setup kar diya hai.
18/03/26, 6:52 pm - Pranab bhai: Great, fake customer ka call log bhi attach karna hai kya?
18/03/26, 6:55 pm - Pooja didi: Haan Pranab, full realistic lagna chahiye trainees ko.
18/03/26, 7:00 pm - Raju bhai: Merchant account waala UPI link test kiya tumne Pooja R.?
18/03/26, 7:04 pm - Pranab bhai: Main check kiya tha, PIN maangne waala screen barabar aa raha hai.
18/03/26, 7:08 pm - Pooja R.: Perfect! Victim ko lagna chahiye ki paise credit ho rahe hain, debit nahi.
18/03/26, 7:12 pm - Raju bhai: Exactly, yehi sabse common trick hai scam me.
18/03/26, 7:15 pm - Pranab bhai: Maine test transaction kar ke dekha Rs 5000 ka dummy account me.
18/03/26, 7:19 pm - Pooja didi: Trainees ko ye samajhna hoga ki UPI PIN sirf money send karne ke liye hota hai.
18/03/26, 7:22 pm - Pooja R.: Sahi baat hai, receive karne ke liye PIN kabhi zarurat nahi hoti.
18/03/26, 7:26 pm - Raju bhai: Test transaction ka screenshot presentation slide me add kar do.
18/03/26, 7:30 pm - Pranab bhai: Sure, main abhi audit log me entry kar raha hu.
18/03/26, 7:34 pm - Pooja R.: Ek minute, test account me actual balance change hua kya?
18/03/26, 7:38 pm - Pooja didi: Pranab bhai, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
18/03/26, 7:41 pm - Pranab bhai: Haan didi, main server log se remove kar deta hu abhi.
18/03/26, 7:45 pm - Raju bhai: Dhyan se karna, training database confuse nahi hona chahiye.
18/03/26, 7:48 pm - Pooja R.: Next scenario cash-back scam waala cover karein?
18/03/26, 7:52 pm - Pooja didi: Haan, scratch card waala fake link dikhao trainees ko.
18/03/26, 7:56 pm - Raju bhai: Wo phishing URL generate kar liya kya Pranab bhai?
18/03/26, 8:01 pm - Pranab bhai: Ji Raju bhai, test domain create ho gaya hai safely sandbox me.
18/03/26, 8:06 pm - Pooja R.: Nice, PPT me links embedded hain already.
18/03/26, 8:12 pm - Raju bhai: Kal subah 10 baje session start hai na?
18/03/26, 8:18 pm - Pranab bhai: Haan, 10 am sharp meeting room 3 me.
18/03/26, 8:24 pm - Pooja didi: Sabhi case materials ka backup drive pe upload kar dena.
18/03/26, 8:30 pm - Pooja R.: Done didi, main upload kar rahi hu.
18/03/26, 8:36 pm - Raju bhai: Perfect, chalo aaj ka review wrap up karte hain.
18/03/26, 8:40 pm - Pranab bhai: Okay Raju bhai, good night everyone.
18/03/26, 8:45 pm - Pooja R.: Good night all, see you tomorrow!
